entries.name: Crayon
entries.medium: wax crayon on toothed paper: back-and-forth scribble fills that skip the valleys, a darker crayon on the shade side, a white one burnishing the highlight, a fat contour gone over twice

entries.name: Cyanotype blueprint
entries.medium: ruling pen and spring-bow compass in white ink on Prussian-blue cyanotype stock

entries.name: Broken colour
entries.medium: opaque oil dabs from a loaded flat hog brush on primed linen, unmixed colours side by side for the eye to mix

entries.name: Charcoal, erased and redrawn
entries.medium: vine and compressed charcoal on heavy rag paper, stumped, lifted with a kneaded eraser, redrawn over its own residue

entries.name: Coloured pencil
entries.medium: wax coloured pencils hatched in one diagonal on toothy cream cartridge paper, hues layered, darks cross-hatched

entries.name: Dream glaze
entries.medium: resin-thinned oil glazes laid with a very small soft brush on a smooth white ground: no visible stroke, every form turned pixel by pixel under one low sun, every edge hard

entries.name: Hand embroidery
entries.medium: stranded cotton floss stitched through natural plain-weave linen in a beech hoop

entries.name: Flat vector
entries.medium: pen-tool paths in a vector app, flat fills that land when a path closes, long-shadow shapes with a transparency ramp, a raster grain brush over the shade sides

entries.name: Folk-tale storybook
entries.medium: gouache and watercolour over an HB pencil drawing on cream cartridge: opaque, dry-brushed paint in the foreground thinning to a pale wash and then to bare pencil in the distance

entries.name: Cut-paper collage
entries.medium: zero drawn lines: torn pieces with a white fibrous edge, scissor pieces crisp, each lifting a soft shadow off the piece below

entries.name: Newsprint halftone
entries.medium: web-offset newspaper print: black on a 45 degree AM screen plus one orange spot at 15 degrees, oil ink gaining into unbleached groundwood newsprint

entries.name: Isometric cutaway
entries.medium: flat vector planes on a true 2:1 isometric grid, three tones per material, crisp edges, pen-tool order

entries.name: Marker comic
entries.medium: alcohol-marker cel fills with a hard shadow edge under one heavy contour that thickens away from the light

entries.name: Risograph
entries.medium: soy ink, one layer per drum multiplied through its own registration offset; every other colour an overprint, tone a halftone screen per ink angle, white is bare paper

entries.name: Low-poly
entries.medium: triangle meshes projected by hand through a pinhole camera, each facet flat-shaded by its normal against one low sun, painter-sorted far to near; no 3D engine

entries.name: Single-line engraving
entries.medium: one unbroken engraved line whose width follows a procedural tone field: the whole picture is a single stroke

entries.name: Mid-century gouache
entries.medium: opaque matte designer's gouache on warm illustration board, a dry brush dragged over the flats, a loose brush-and-ink line printed off register

entries.name: Chalkboard
entries.medium: side-of-the-chalk scumble on a slate board, lit limbs worked twice, every stroke broken by the board's tooth with dust either side, ghosts of old lessons

entries.name: Oil on canvas
entries.medium: opaque oil paint with hog-bristle brushes on a toned linen canvas, lean block-in to fat impasto

entries.name: Toy-theatre paper collage
entries.medium: a cardboard toy theatre: patterned and sugar papers cut and torn, gouache-painted cut-outs with a white sticker margin, every piece with a card edge and a gap to the flat behind

entries.name: Pixel art
entries.medium: a 120x120 grid of cells, each one of 16 declared palette colours, laid one cell at a time and blown up by a whole number, no smoothing

entries.name: Ballpoint sketch
entries.medium: one blue ballpoint on cream cartridge, near-constant weight; tone only from where the hatching sits, plus the blob where a firm stroke stops

entries.name: Pencil & watercolour
entries.medium: graphite and pan watercolour on cold-press: washes that never quite fill their outline, form shaded toward one light, graphite over the paint

entries.name: Rubber hose
entries.medium: India ink at one pressure on a clear cel over a blue-pencil rough, flat grey paint on the back, photographed and printed on black-and-white film

entries.name: Archival scrapbook
entries.medium: foxed rag-paper album page; torn cards, cellulose tape, a clothespin on twine; copperplate engravings hand-tinted; typewriter, ransom-note cut letters, red pen, rubber stamp

entries.name: Scratchboard
entries.medium: white china clay under black India ink; every mark is ink scraped away with a knife or scratch nib

entries.name: Pen-and-ink stipple
entries.medium: one 0.25 mm technical pen dotted straight down onto hot-press bristol; tone is dot density only

entries.name: Storybook pencil + watercolour
entries.medium: storybook graphite and gentle pan watercolour, drawn for a recurring character

entries.name: Sumi-e ink painting
entries.medium: one loaded soft brush of sumi ink, five dilutions, on unsized absorbent xuan paper, with a cinnabar seal

entries.name: Toy brick
entries.medium: moulded ABS toy bricks, rendered flat-plastic in orthographic view: face tones by the cube rule, bevel highlights, seam hairlines, real studs, a soft ground shadow

entries.name: Ukiyo-e colour woodblock
entries.medium: water-based pigment printed by baren from hand-carved cherry blocks onto damp kozo washi: a sumi keyblock, flat colour blocks, bokashi wipes

entries.name: Ink & line-wash
entries.medium: wet washes first that flood past the line and settle along each shape's bottom edge, backruns, then a flexible nib thick on the press and hair-thin on the lift
